pages.text: 1. Craft a $(item)Resource Farm$() (see $(l:easy_farms:farms/resource_farm)The Farms$()).$(br2)2. Put a $(item)Coal Ore$() in an input slot and an $(item)iron pickaxe$() in the tool slot.$(br2)3. Wait. Coal comes out of the output slots. Hoppers and pipes can pull it out.
4. Swap the pickaxe for a better one for more speed, and enchant it: $(item)Fortune$() gives more drops.$(br2)5. Try the upgrade cards in the $(l:easy_farms:cards/overview)Upgrades screen$().
